counterfactual_missing_items: no signal alterations in the posterior circulation or brainstem
decisive_items: EEG findings:  Title: Right hemispheric rhythmic activities
quasi-periodic fashion at intervals of about one second, during which the patient presented significant dizziness, vertigo and dull response
response.rationale: EEG clearly shows right frontal rhythmic epileptiform discharges synchronized with the prodromal symptoms, strongly supporting focal epilepsy. TIA and vertebrobasilar insufficiency lack supportive MRI changes or brainstem signs; hypertensive encephalopathy is incomplete and doesn't explain the focal EEG findings.

rejected.why: Hypertensive encephalopathy doesn't produce a specific EEG pattern and the symptoms are transient, not a global cephalic state.
Vertebrobasilar insufficiency is contradicted by normal posterior circulation MRI and the absence of brainstem neurological deficits.
